title: [CAP/TAP] Finance guide (US only)
label: TIKTOK SHOP · PARTNER GUIDE
subtitle: Updated 2025-12-15
html:
Finance

The finance feature allows partners, including Creator Agency Partner (CAP) & TikTok Shop Affiliate Partner (TAP), to review and export orders and bills after sharing commissions with Creators.

Payment Accounts

The Payment Accounts section allows partners to set up and update bank accounts to receive payouts. First, partners need to activate their payment accounts for the relevant market. After activation, you must link your bank account and successfully pass verification to receive payouts. Steps are as follows:

Step 1 Go to Finance -> Payment Account and click on 'Activate Account.'
Step 2 Fill in the required information.
Step 3 Wait for the results of the payment account review.
Step 4 If the review is approved, you can proceed to link your bank account.
Step 5 Enter the bank account information.
Step 6 The bank account has been successfully linked.

Earnings

The Earnings section lists all commission orders from creators who have a fee agreement with the partner. At the top of this page, you can view an overview of your commission data, including:

  • Not Paid: This represents the amount has not yet been transferred to your bank account. Possible reasons include:
    • Orders are not yet completed.
    • The payout failed due to errors in your bank account details. Please verify your information and click 'Request Payment' to retry. If it still fails, submit a ticket for assistance.
    • Your earnings have not yet reached the payout threshold, which is $1.00 for US local partners. You can go to the 'Pending payment' and 'Payment failed' tab to check details.
  • Paid: this amount reflects the funds that have been successfully transferred to your bank account. You can check details under the 'Paid' tab.

You can also export the commission order details to an Excel file for easier reconciliation. Note: due to US data compliance, when the market is the US, US CB partners can only export the earnings data of Carved-Out creators

2.1 When will I receive the commission?

Starting April 15, 2025(UTC+0), you will receive commissions based on the following rules:

  • You will typically receive commission 15 days after the order delivery date.
  • Some orders may take longer due to:
    • Commissions are paid only after the seller's orders are settled. Therefore, if the seller's settlement period is longer, such as Delivery + 31 days, commissions will also be paid to you 31 days after delivery.
    • Commissions can't be paid until the dispute, refund, or return requests are resolved.

2.2 What is the impact of the creator settlement rule change effective April 15, 2025?

Prior to the change, you typically receive commission within 15 days (which could be 1, 5, 8, or 15 days) after the order delivery date, up to 31 days after delivery. Under the new rules, you will typically receive commission on the 15th day after the order delivery date, up to 31 days after delivery. For orders created after April 15, 2025, commission will be paid following the new rules. You may experience a temporary earnings dip for about half of the month post-change, but cash flow will normalize over time.

Payment Bills

The Payments section displays the records of successful payouts, which you can use to reconcile with your bank statements.

If you want to view the commission details for each payment ID, go to the Paid tab on the Earnings page to export the commission order details. You can use the payment ID column to locate the corresponding orders.

TikTok Shop automatically initiates daily payouts to your selected payout method once your earnings reach the minimum payout threshold. The minimum payout thresholds for local and cross-border partners are as follows:

Type CAP & TAP Region Payout Method Minimum Payout Payment Currency Time of Fund Arrival
L2L US Bank account 1.00 USD 1-7 business days
Cross-boarder CN Bank account 0.01 CNY Generally 1-7 business days. Overseas issue banks may need extra processing time
Lianlian 0.01 CNH/USD 1 business day
PingPong 0.01 CNH/USD 1 business day
Airwallex 0.01 CNH/USD 1 business day
HK Bank account 0.01 USD Generally 1-7 business days. Overseas issue banks may need extra processing time
Lianlian 0.01 USD 1 business day
PingPong 0.01 USD 1 business day
Airwallex 0.01 USD 1 business day
*Please note that online settlement is not yet available for US cross-border CAP, so the information above does not apply to it.

Tax Information

CAP and TAP must submit a W-9 form (for US local partners) or a W-8 form (for cross-border partners) to start a campaign.
